guards.rationale: Re-verdicted from waiver to FAITHFUL by the 2026-07-26 relic fix pass. SCOPE RULING (2026-07-26 relic fix pass, applied at every potion site in this tier). The shared contract's 'Out of scope everywhere: potions (deferred by Perry)' means POTION IS NOT AN AUDITED KIND -- there is no `potion` roster kind and no `audit/records/potion/`. It does NOT mean that potion-affecting behaviour of an AUDITED relic is invisible. The relic tier itself already reads it that way at the overwhelming majority of its sites: 45 relic gap entries across 25 records turn on potion mechanics, 27 of them tagged LIVE (relic/belt_buckle, relic/cauldron, relic/sozu, relic/delicate_frond, relic/petrified_toad, relic/tiny_mailbox, relic/white_beast_statue, relic/wongos_mystery_ticket, relic/phial_holster G1 ...), against only four records that waived on the exclusion. Binding rule 3 forces one answer and the majority is also the better-reasoned side: potions ARE ported (51 registered classes, 48 in the reward pool) and the belt is conformance-asserted -- sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py:847 diffs `floor_potions` slot by slot and sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py:925-933 reads `max_potions` (2026-08-04: re-verified after line drift, same shape). A divergence the conformance runner asserts on is by definition one a replay sees, which is the README's definition of a gap. Under that ruling a waiver here was a vocabulary error twice over: the behaviour is in scope, and the port implements it CORRECTLY, so there is nothing to decline. `run.add_potion_slots` (sts2_rl/run.py:870-877, re-verified 2026-08-04 after run.py drift) is Player.cs's SetMaxPotionCountInternal grow path -- it raises `max_potions` and appends `count` null slots, never compacting -- and the shrink path is unported because nothing in ported content shrinks the belt. EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/relic_probes_b12.py b12-phial`): `phial_holster: max_potions=4`, i.e. 3 -> 4, matching `DynamicVar('PotionSlots', 1m)` (PhialHolster.cs:28; no AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension in the file). The old verdict also had a second cost worth naming: relic/potion_belt cited this waiver as precedent for waiving the OPPOSITE mechanism -- a GainMaxPotionCount the port drops entirely -- so a waiver on a correctly-ported behaviour was actively shielding a live gap. potion_belt's AfterObtained and guard N1 are now gaps.
